goal: Shell script review: quoting, error handling, temporary files and command injection.
use: Shell script review: quoting, error handling, temporary files and command injection. Use when asked to review a shell script or pipeline step.

steps.note: Read the script. Its shell, its arguments and the commands it calls.
Check quoting. Flag unquoted variables that can split or expand.
Check errors. Flag scripts without strict mode or error checks.
Check temporary files. Flag predictable temporary names.
Report. Each finding with line, severity and the fix.
